continuity_scope: The King's Avatar, official English WebNovel publication, opening segment limited to Chapter 1, “The Banished Battle God.” This pass excludes the remainder of the web novel, any original-language witness not directly accessed here, donghua, manhua/comic, live-action, games, prequels, side stories, and all adaptations.

work_or_witnesses.work: The King's Avatar, Chapter 1: The Banished Battle God

coverage_rule: Include named individual dramatic characters who materially act or react in the accessible official Chapter 1 text: Ye Qiu, Sun Xiang, and Su Mucheng. The series synopsis's “Ye Xiu” form is not merged with Chapter 1’s “Ye Qiu” because the selected official evidence does not explicitly establish the two forms as one person. Avatars/accounts, teams, classes, skills, equipment, game systems, and places remain terms, not character nodes.
omissions: The unnamed club manager and unnamed team members, because they lack individual names in the opening segment.
The series-synopsis name form “Ye Xiu,” which is not promoted to a separate character record or joined to Ye Qiu without explicit source evidence.
Ever-Stay, Glory, account cards, teams, the Alliance, classes, skills, and equipment as character nodes.
All material after Chapter 1; original-language, donghua, manhua/comic, live-action, game, prequel, side-story, and other adaptation material.
content_cautions: Chapter 1 includes simulated game-combat imagery and professional displacement, including transfer of an account card and pressure to retire. This narrow pass does not generalize those events as real-world violence or catalog later content.
The account and avatar vocabulary belongs to the story's game-fiction layer; it is not treated as separate human identity or evidence of a separate dramatic individual.
No real-world Chinese esports team, game, profession, or location equivalence is assigned to the fictional organizations and game system.
uncertainties: The WebNovel series page calls the protagonist Ye Xiu, while the accessible opening chapter calls the player Ye Qiu. No explicit source statement in the selected segment links those forms, so their relationship is left unresolved.

The platform identifies Butterfly Blue as author and Nomyummi and GravityTales as translators, but it does not expose Chinese-script character names in the selected evidence; no Chinese-script or pinyin variant is inferred.
The selected opening segment establishes only its immediate account-transfer conflict; no later career, team, avatar, equipment, or adaptation detail is imported.

The direct chapter-reader URL presents an English chapter under a locale-specific WebNovel path; it is treated as the official platform's available opening-text locator, not as an independently verified translation edition.
evidence_basis: WebNovel's official English series page provides author/translator and high-level platform metadata. Its official Chapter 1 reader provides the primary opening-segment evidence for Ye Qiu, Sun Xiang, Su Mucheng, Ever-Stay, and the account transfer. The official catalog bounds the selected Chapter 1 within Volume 1. No fan wiki or Wikipedia was used.
